[m53] page: Changing directions | heading: Left turns · ¶5 | text
Wait for the smaller vehicle to move right before you pass.

[c6] page: Changing directions | heading: Left turns · ¶5 | text
If you are making a left turn behind one of these vehicles, do not pull up beside it to make your turn at the same time.

[c7] page: Changing directions | heading: Left turns · ¶5 | text
Stay behind and turn when the way is clear.

[m19] page: Changing directions | heading: Left-turn lanes · ¶3 | text
These left-turn lanes are not to be used for passing.

Write the reading notes for all 4 passages, then the statements, following sections 4 and 5. Return only the JSON object.

passages.says: rule: wait for a smaller vehicle to move right before passing it when making a left turn

statements.note: The context of 'making a left turn' is inferred from the heading 'Left turns' and the surrounding context of c6/c7 which discuss turning behind vehicles.

sources.quote: If you are making a left turn behind one of these vehicles, do not pull up beside it to make your turn at the same time.

statements.note: The phrase 'one of these vehicles' refers to vehicles discussed in the preceding context (likely larger or slower vehicles), but the rule applies to any vehicle ahead in the lane when turning left.

statements.text: a driver SHOULD stay behind the vehicle AND turn WHEN the driver is making a left turn behind the vehicle UNTIL the way is clear
